description: MainActivity class for an Android app managing navigation drawer and bottom navigation, setting up and switching between Home, Dashboard, and Settings fragments.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the app's navigation drawer and bottom navigation with fragment transactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes layout, navigation components, fragments, and back press behavior.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves currently selected navigation item to handle configuration changes.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles 'up' navigation by opening the drawer.

methods.name: ensureFragmentsCreated
methods.description: Creates and adds fragments for each tab if not already added.

methods.name: showDestination
methods.description: Switches visible fragment based on selected navigation item, updates title and UI.

methods.name: syncNavigationSelection
methods.description: Synchronizes selection state across navigation UI components.
